companies.name: DHANLAXMI
companies.summary: Dhanlaxmi Crop Science Limited engages in the manufacturing and processing business of agriculture seeds in India. Its crop and vegetable seeds portfolio include cotton, wheat, cumin, bajra, maize, gram, okra, green gram, SSG, soyabean, milky, mustard, groundnut, black gram, guar, castor, sesame, animal feed, corn, moong, jowar, van guar, coriander, red gram, green pea, multifeed, onion, etc. The company also offers consultancy services to farmers and agricultural businesses. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Himatnagar, India.
